quote: Vendor maintains a list of subprocessors at vendor.example/subprocessors. Vendor will update the list within 30 days of any change.
policy_quote: Vendor must notify us in writing at least 30 days before adding a new subprocessor. Violation: no notice requirement, or notice <30 days.
reason: The list is updated within 30 days after a change. The policy requires written notice at least 30 days before a new subprocessor is added. After-the-fact publication is not prior notice.
suggested_fix: Require at least 30 days' prior written notice before any new subprocessor is engaged, with a right to object.
